acceptance_criteria: A fresh user can hand this skill to a supported terminal agent, approve a bounded plan once, obtain a functioning dashboard and retained evidence, resume after session loss, and handle a connector need without copying secrets or executing setup by hand. Actual client/OAuth and multi-day outcomes are separately qualified; unit tests do not close the epic.
description: The human supplies goals, authorized targets and approvals; their coding agent scaffolds, starts, verifies, resumes and reports. Skill scripts own deterministic local state, not model reasoning or external OAuth. Keep existing measurement/report authority, private data boundaries and explicit external-action permissions. No supplied Gemini review content has been received; it is not a design input yet.
title: Agent-owned VPS investigation with minimal human work

acceptance_criteria: Read-only plan; one approval applies to the reviewed bounded operations; wrong hash, changed target/config/source or mismatched existing workspace refused. Existing identical runtime returns its identity without duplication.
description: Agent determines the authorized target/environment first, reuses a matching workspace and emits one bounded plan. No broad credential or network discovery. Plan hash binds source, target, settings and duration, not a claim of consent.
title: Discover explicit scope and produce an idempotent executable plan

acceptance_criteria: Test actual cold CLI start, exact URL/port, idempotent concurrent start, source/config change, direct process identity, natural budget completion, stop, crash/stale record and preserved history. End tests with no workers left.
description: One owned Linux worker launches detached with bounded lifetime, loopback dashboard, private progress and cooperative stop. Never kill arbitrary/reused PIDs or compete with manual collection. No root/system service, silent restart or reboot-survival claim.
title: Manage collector and viewer beyond a terminal-agent session

acceptance_criteria: CLI and HTML agree on running/stopped/stale state. Distinguish process liveness, collector evidence and multi-day readiness. Resume preserves old data and surfaces next safe operation.
description: Human sees actual managed state and blocking questions in the existing viewer; a new agent reads private HANDOFF.md plus machine status and continues instead of repeating manual instructions. No browser terminal or hidden mutation API.
title: Expose agent progress and recovery in the dashboard

acceptance_criteria: Explicit request has stable schema, minimal scope, purpose and expected result. Missing capability asks the user for the native OAuth/approval step once, not manual token copying. Read, draft and send are distinct permissions. No installed connector implies send authority.
description: Skill instructs Codex/Claude/other agents to use live tool registry and approved connector discovery. Local capability requests declare intent/data/minimum scopes; they cannot create OAuth access or pretend a connection exists.
title: Discover host-native connector capabilities only when needed

acceptance_criteria: End-to-end tests with actual authorized connector route or controlled sandbox show read/draft/send distinctions, stale approval rejection, recipient/content binding and uncertain-outcome recovery. No raw customer data becomes public.
description: For requested mail/calendar/provider actions, use host-native tools, verified recipient/thread, current reviewed payload and returned receipt. Handle unknown outcomes without blind retries. Existing support-contact prohibition remains until a fresh explicit request.
title: Bind external actions to reviewed content and verified results

acceptance_criteria: Fresh-install and resume sessions on at least Codex and Claude Code produce an audited task trace. Target selection, connector gaps and handoff work without fabricated tool names or unapproved hooks. Failures become synthetic regressions.
description: Tests of Python/HTML do not prove a real terminal coding agent activates the skill and scaffolds correctly. Define minimal prompts and count manual interventions; use actual approved client accounts only.
title: Qualify cold Codex and Claude Code user journeys

acceptance_criteria: Every expected asset retains measured, unresolved, excluded or inaccessible state. No silent full-account claim. Platform-specific persistence/remote access and reconnect behavior verified before offered as automatic.
description: One VPS, existing metrics fleet and remote authorized Linux host are distinct routes. Inventory remains declared vs discovered; Windows/macOS lifecycle/system scheduler support needs its own tests.
title: Cover heterogeneous estates and non-Linux agent hosts

acceptance_criteria: Multi-day evidence and repeatable decision checks on representative setups, bounded storage and meaningful unknowns. CPU accounting never claims complete disk/network/application diagnosis. Reboot durability explicitly handled or excluded.
description: Runtime existence is not continuous evidence. Exercise retention, gaps, pressure, service impact, stopped processes, restart and source epochs over real durations using synthetic faults and authorized passive hosts.
title: Validate multi-day operation and measurement usefulness

acceptance_criteria: New failures map to smallest owning regression. Exported skill/release integrity, privacy and actual-runtime tests gate updates; no paid skill bodies or private captures in repository.
description: Learn from agent friction and monitoring failures without importing hostile logs as instructions. Preserve sanitized proposals and tests; never rewrite thresholds, install connectors or grant actions autonomously.
title: Make self-improvement a reviewed evidence-to-regression loop
